<issue>
MatchStar name gets reversed when assigned

#### Description

When creating a MatchStar node with a name, the name gets unexpectedly reversed. This affects pattern matching functionality where starred expressions should preserve their original variable names.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import astroid

code = """
match status:
    case [x, 2, _, *rest]:
        pass
"""

node = astroid.parse(code)
match_node = node.body[0]
case = match_node.cases[0]
pattern_seq = case.pattern
match_star = pattern_seq.patterns[3]

print(f"Expected name: rest")
print(f"Actual name: {match_star.name.name}")
```

Expected output:
```
Expected name: rest
Actual name: rest
```

Actual output:
```
Expected name: rest
Actual name: tser
```

The variable name in starred patterns gets reversed, which breaks pattern matching semantics and variable assignment behavior.
</issue>
